sources.observation: FE sends START_SETUP_REVISION, APPEND_SETUP_MESSAGE, REVISE_CONTEXT and APPLY_SETUP_REVISION; exact-test display compares digest and generations.
manage uses installation advisory transaction lock; Apply checks owner and completed setup, calls eligibility, persists active context and projection outbox; liveEnabled=false.
Requires current definition and authority/source/retrieval generations and every required acceptance scenario on the exact context/session target.
Primary-DB projector dispatch selects pending events with pessimistic lock/skip_locked and per-installation aggregate ordering; registered projector handles semantics.
Registers chatbot projector and checks projection event/sequence identity before applying the accepted-context projection.

acceptance.given: Authenticated user belongs to another installation owner.

acceptance.then: Server refuses; active context, liveEnabled and projection rows remain unchanged.

acceptance.given: Owner has a completed setup context and all required exact-target acceptance scenarios pass.

acceptance.instrument: Future sequential browser flow plus server read-back and actual screenshots/video.

acceptance.then: Server returns setup-target-stale; no active-context/projection mutation.

acceptance.given: Apply already succeeded for an installation and idempotency key.
acceptance.when: Repeat the same request, then reuse key with a different context.
acceptance.then: Same event/context is no-op; conflicting context is rejected; no duplicate projection effect.
acceptance.instrument: Idempotency and transaction integration tests; not executed.
